meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 把 Resend 邮件适配器复制进 src/channels/ 并注册、安装依赖,再构建并跑注册测试;随后引导你填 Resend API key、webhook secret 与发件地址,把你的邮箱设为 owner,并发一封 hello 邮件。
howto.when: 当你要求接入 Resend 邮件渠道,或在 /setup 流程中需要加邮件通道时接管;适配器装好但邮件不通、发送报 401 或收不到回复时,也用它跑测试排查。

say.text: 帮我把 Resend 邮件渠道接进来
say.note: 复制适配器、注册、装依赖并跑测试

say.text: 把我的邮箱设为 owner,并发一封 hello 邮件
say.note: 它会先问你邮箱和该由哪个 agent 应答

howto.what_en: Installs the Resend email adapter: copies it into src/channels/, registers it, installs @resend/chat-sdk-adapter, builds and runs the test. Then prompts for your API key and webhook secret, wires your email as owner and sends a hello.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the Resend email channel or need an email channel during /setup; also used to run the registration test or restart the service when email doesn't flow.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel for me
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, installs the dependency and runs the test

say_en.text: Wire my email as owner and send me a hello email
say_en.note: It first asks for your address and which agent should reply
